senses.gloss: f. (בלע) [absorption,] payment for a thing included in the bargain (and not mentioned); indirect sale or purchase.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 27b:2">Erub. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>שנתן דמי … בד׳</he> he paid the full value of the salt and water indirectly (by paying so much more for the oil for which he bargained).
<cite ref="Bekhorot 31b:13">Bekh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מוכרין אותו בה׳</he> it is sold in connection with other things.
<cite ref="Nedarim 37a:7">Ned. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ היא</he> the teacher’s fee for the Sabbath lessons is included in the general engagement (by the week, the month &c.).
